script: Is Diego Simeone about to build the most toxic defense in football history with Cristian Romero? Cristian Romero is a World Cup winner and one of the best defenders on the planet, but he's also picked up six red cards during his time at Tottenham, which is more than any other Premier League player in that stretch. Referees know him well because he plays right on the edge of every single rule. But the red cards aren't the reason this move has people talking, they're just the warning label on it. Right now, Atletico Madrid want him badly, and their manager Diego Simeone is personally pushing for the deal even though his teams are famous for being some of the most combative, dark sides in world football. Atletico already made a bid worth around 30 million euros and Tottenham said no, so a bigger offer is being prepared, and Romero has already agreed personal terms while actually preferring Atletico over clubs like Inter and Barcelona. But once you hear what Simeone actually likes about him, this stops sounding like a normal transfer. Simeone doesn't want Romero in spite of the aggression, he wants him because of it. And this is the same Romero who this season alone missed six matches through suspension. He got sent off for a heavy challenge on Casemiro this season, and earlier in that same season he was fined 50,000 pounds by the FA for how he acted toward a referee after a different red card against Liverpool. So is Simeone about to build the most toxic defense in football history? If this deal happens, he's pairing the most-carded man in England with the darkest playstyle in Spain, and yes, it could be exactly that.
